C2V-02.q_theta_formula: unique value that zeros the hinge bracket after spring and centrifugal terms

C2V-03.load_formula: Q_phi*(t) and q_theta*(t) solve the target equations at the target state and accelerations

C2V-04.power_formula: P = Qm*omega + Q_phi*omega + N*q_theta*theta_dot + N*Qh*theta_dot - N*b*theta_dot^2 - N*tau_c*theta_dot*tanh(theta_dot/v)

C2V-05.reference: DOP853 Reference A and Reference B on the independent C2V-03 right-hand side

C2V-08.zero_actuation: two knots spanning the subcase duration
